label: Parat-Bridge
info: Configuration UI for Parat-Bridge. Handles setup of Rayvn API credentials and WaSOS login. Validates input, authenticates with both services, and stores configuration in global variables.

name: Store Rayvn Config
info: Stores Rayvn configuration in global variable rayvnConfig as an object. Handles both API key (rayvn_api_key topic) and log name (log_name topic). Updates existing config without overwriting other fields.

name: Store WaSOS Config
info: Stores WaSOS configuration (username and chatroom) in global variable wasosConfig. Does NOT store password permanently for security reasons - password is only passed in msg for immediate use. Updates existing config without overwriting other fields.

name: Process Rayvn Submit
info: Validates that both API key and log name are filled in. If something is missing, logs a warning and returns null (no message is sent). If OK, builds HTTP request to Rayvn API (/logs endpoint) with Authorization Bearer token to fetch list of available logs. Passes config in msg for later use.

name: Process WaSOS Submit
info: Validates that username, password, and chatroom are filled in. If something is missing, returns error (output 1). If OK, builds message for WasosLogin subflow with URL, username, and password. Builds and stores chatroom URL (wasosChatroomUrl) and name (wasosChatroomName) in global variables. Deletes temporary password after use. Sends to output 2 for login process.

Runs the WaSOS login process with provided credentials. Returns nonce (API key) which is stored in wasos_apikey by the subflow. This is the actual authentication against the WaSOS system.

This node abstracts the following flow:

Config (Function Node - inside subflow)
Prepares WaSOS login request. Stores base URL in global variable wasos_url, builds login endpoint (/apisec/login), and creates Basic Authentication header from username and password (Base64-encoded). Gets values either from msg or environment variables.

Request API key (HTTP Request Node - inside subflow)
Sends POST request to WaSOS login endpoint with Basic Auth. Returns a nonce (API key) used for authentication in all subsequent API calls.

Set wasos_apikey (Function Node - inside subflow)
Stores the received nonce from WaSOS login as global variable wasos_apikey. This is used as x-api-key header in all subsequent WaSOS API requests.

name: Password Temp Storage
info: Stores the password temporarily in global variable temp_password. This is a security mechanism - the password is deleted immediately after use in the login process, so it doesn't remain permanently in global context.

name: WaSOS Login Success Message
info: Generates user-friendly message based on login result. Checks if nonce exists in response: If yes, shows success message with chatroom name (green). If no, shows error message to check credentials (red).

name: GET to fetch logs
info: Fetches all logs from Rayvn API that the user has access to. Returns list of logs used to find the correct log ID based on the provided log name.

name: Resolve Log ID
info: Finds correct log ID from Rayvn response based on the log name the user entered. Does case-insensitive matching of log names. Handles three scenarios: no match (error), multiple matches (error - requires admin), or one match (success). On success, stores log ID in global variable rayvnLogId and shows success message with name and ID.
